v0.1.0.description:
Initial release of the Puzzle Bobble 4 Archipelago integration.

Included files

.apworld: installable Archipelago world.

.exe: Puzzle Bobble 4 client for DuckStation.

.yaml: configuration template for generating a game.

.zip: PopTracker package.

See the repository README for setup instructions and requirements.
v0.1.0.title: Puzzle Bobble 4 for Archipelago v0.1.0

v1.0.0.description:
The final release of Puzzle Bobble 4 for Archipelago!

PuzzleBobble4ArchipelagoClient.exe – The client application that connects Puzzle Bobble 4 to an Archipelago server and handles in-game interactions.

puzzlebobble4.apworld – The Archipelago world file. Required to generate and host a Puzzle Bobble 4 game.

PuzzleBobble4.yaml – The YAML configuration file containing the available game options and settings.

PuzzleBobble4PopTracker.zip – The PopTracker package for tracking your progression and locations.
v1.0.0.title: Puzzle Bobble 4 for Archipelago v1.0.0
